# Copilot Instructions

This repository is a curated awesome list; `README.md` is the product.

- Follow `AGENTS.md` for how to work here (workflows, decision matrix, stop-and-ask, protected areas).
- Follow `CONTRIBUTING.md` for every curation rule (scope, entry format, links, placement, duplicates). It wins any disagreement.
- Run `npm test` before proposing changes.
